global.title: Pfizer looks to reroute supply after flooding sidelined India injectables plant
global.summary: A Pfizer joint venture with Zydus Cadila in India that manufactures sterile injectables, including chemotherapy drugs for U.S. cancer patients, remains closed after severe flooding in July, with the company estimating that new supplies could begin returning in mid-to-late 2028 un…

global.title: FDA Approves Ilumya for Adults With Active Psoriatic Arthritis
global.summary: Sun Pharma's IL-23 inhibitor tildrakizumab gains a psoriatic arthritis indication; the announcement cited no phase 3 efficacy figures.
